Subject: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP) 2026 – Masters Applicants – Expression of Interest by Feb 15

Dear OGE,

Following the MoU we signed with ETH Zurich in November 2024, I'm writing to flag the ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP) cycle for 2026 entry. This is specifically for students applying to ETH Zurich's master's programmes for autumn 2026 enrollment.

WHAT IS ESOP?
ESOP is ETH Zurich's most prestigious scholarship for incoming international master's students. It provides:
- Full tuition waiver (CHF 730/semester ordinarily)
- Monthly stipend of CHF 11,000 for the duration of the master's degree (typically 2 years, sometimes 1.5 years depending on programme)
- Mentoring from an ETH professor
- Invitation to ETH's Excellence programme social and networking events

Only a small number of scholarships are awarded globally each cycle. Our MoU gives Plaksha students priority consideration if nominated through OGE.

ELIGIBLE STUDENTS:
This scholarship is exclusively for students applying to begin a master's programme at ETH Zurich. It is NOT for exchange or internship students. Relevant ETH master's programmes:
- MSc Computer Science (2 years)
- MSc Electrical Engineering and Information Technology (1.5 years)
- MSc Robotics, Systems and Control (1.5 years)
- MSc Data Science (1.5 years)
- MSc Mechanical Engineering (2 years)

Students must have applied (or be in the process of applying) to the ETH master's directly via ETH's admissions portal. The ESOP nomination is a separate process submitted by Plaksha/OGE.

Given the nature of this scholarship (master's level, STEM fields), it is intended for our graduating / final-year undergraduate students who are planning to pursue a master's abroad.

SCHOLARSHIP REQUIREMENTS (set by ETH):
- Outstanding academic record — ETH expects a GPA equivalent to top 5–10% of graduating class
- Demonstrated research experience or project work in the relevant field
- A clear and specific motivation for the chosen ETH programme (generic applications are unsuccessful)
- One ETH professor willing to serve as mentor — OGE has contact information for 3 ETH faculty who have agreed to mentor Plaksha nominees

PLAKSHA INTERNAL NOMINATION DEADLINE: February 15, 2026
ETH ESOP application portal deadline: March 1, 2026

DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR INTERNAL NOMINATION:
- CV (academic focus, research and projects highlighted)
- Research statement (800–1000 words): why this ETH programme, what you will do during the MSc, how it connects to your long-term goals
- Unofficial transcript
- Evidence of any publications, conference presentations, or significant project work
- Confirmation of ETH master's application reference number (or planned submission date)

INTERNAL PROCESS:
Given the competitive and high-profile nature of this nomination, OGE would like sign-off from both the relevant Program Chair / Department Head and the Dean before we submit to ETH. Please ensure the student packet is reviewed for academic quality before forwarding.

Reach me at partnerships@plaksha.edu.in for any questions.

Best,
Dr. Ananya Krishnan
Head, International Academic Partnerships
Office of Global Engagement, Plaksha University
